related.title: 資料庫交易與日誌
related.why: WAL 與交易不變量提供還原依據
related.whyEn: WAL and transaction invariants support restoration
related.transfer: WAL 與交易不變量提供還原依據
related.transferEn: WAL and transaction invariants support restoration
related.difference: 交易正常提交不等於跨區還原可用
related.differenceEn: Normal commits do not establish cross-region restorability
practice: 由「RPO」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「交易正常提交不等於跨區還原可用」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From rpo, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Normal commits do not establish cross-region restorability", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.year: 公開技術脈絡 / Public technical context
history.title: 業務目標與範圍
history.text: 官方公開資料「PostgreSQL 時點復原」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「RPO」及「RTO」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference PostgreSQL point-in-time recovery supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with rpo and rto before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
